description:
Post a surety bond behind an agent's promises. principal is a positive
    integer in minor units; expires_at is the ISO-8601 coverage window end.
    The bond fee (2% default) is computed and frozen at post.

coverage.description: Optional. What the bond covers, in words.
coverage.title: Coverage

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, for example USD.
currency.title: Currency

expires_at.description: End of the coverage window, ISO-8601.
expires_at.title: Expires At

principal.description: Bond stake in minor units (cents), a positive whole number.
principal.title: Principal

principal_agent.description: Id of the agent whose promises the bond covers.
principal_agent.title: Principal Agent

name: post_bond
title: Post bond
